content.heading: Refund Policy
content.description:
At tezhhomayaa.com, we believe that customer delight takes precedence over anything else. Hence, we are committed to ensuring your satisfaction with any products you have ordered from us.

At tezhhomayaa.com we offer a 14 days return policy. If you are not entirely satisfied with your purchase, you may exchange or return most items bought from Tezhhomayaa.com

You can initiate a refund/exchange by sending an email to customercare@tezhhomayaa.com mentioning the Order number and whether you want a refund or exchange. Alternatively, you can WhatsApp us using the WhatsApp button on our website. You can also log into your account and use the refund/exchange option from within it.

The following terms and conditions shall apply to returns and exchanges.

1. Only products that have not been used can be returned/exchanged.

2. The return of the product must be done in the original packing it was received.

3. The returned product must be accompanied by the original tags and invoice.

4. Upon receipt of the returned product, we will inspect and confirm that the product is not used and/or damaged. If it is found that the product is used and / or damaged, no refund/exchange will be made.

5. The refund shall be made only in the same mode in which the payment was received except in the case of Cash on Delivery. In the case of Cash on Delivery, the amount paid will be converted into credit points (in form of a discount code) of the same value which can be redeemed for any future purchases on tezhhomayaa.com

6. It can take 7 days to 30 days for the banks to process and credit the funds to your account. We do not have control over this process.

7. Any products purchased during a sale or at a discounted price cannot be returned/exchanged.

WAYS TO RETURN / EXCHANGE
Log in to your account and use Refund or Exchange option. This is the most preferred and quickest method.

Send an email to customercare@tezhhomayaa.com with the subject either of the Return or Exchange, as the case may be, with the order number.
